title: 基于用户画像的嵌套展开策略自适应方法：面向目标导向对话系统的LLM规划
summary: 提出UP-NRPA在线框架，利用大语言模型和实时用户反馈动态定制对话策略，无需离线强化学习。在协作与非协作对话基准测试中实现100%成功率，谈判任务销售列表比提升56.41%。
summary_en: Proposes UP-NRPA, an online framework using LLMs and real-time user feedback to dynamically customize dialogue strategies without offline RL. Achieves 100% success rate on collaborative and non-collaborative benchmarks, with 56.41% improvement in sale-to-list ratio for negotiation tasks.
